api.name: Zepto Register OB Fee Verification
api.description: Registers the outbound OB-fee deduction VERIFICATION result on the partner's existing ticket: the flow's structured fields (deduction_explained, amount_informed, informed_amount, amount_matches, deducted_amount, payment_mode, upfront_amount_paid, deduction_date_or_week, verification_status, additional_concern) + bot/tenant/session ids, language, ticket_id, partner_id. Reserved .example host until the real endpoint exists; sample response in responseSchema.example.

runtime_context.name: Ticket & partner facts (dialer)

testPayload.line_concern: Onboarding fee (OB fee) deduction ticket verification
testPayload.support_action: Zepto Support verifies the onboarding fee deduction ticket with the partner and records the answers on the ticket for the team's follow-up

runtime_context.missingValuePolicy: Never guess an onboarding fee amount, a deducted amount, a store, a date, a policy rule, a ticket number or a timeline. If a value is not in the context, in the partner's own words on this call, or in a system result from this call, do not state it.

summary_fields.name: ticket_type
summary_fields.label: Ticket type
summary_fields.description: The concern type this outbound verification call handles.

summary_fields.name: deduction_explained
summary_fields.label: Deduction explained at onboarding
summary_fields.description: Was the onboarding-fee deduction explained to the rider during onboarding?

summary_fields.name: explanation_given_on_call
summary_fields.label: Onboarding fee explained on this call
summary_fields.description: Did the bot explain the onboarding fee on this call (only when the rider said it was not explained)?

summary_fields.name: amount_informed
summary_fields.label: Deduction amount communicated
summary_fields.description: Was the rider informed about the amount that would be deducted?

summary_fields.name: informed_amount
summary_fields.label: Amount communicated (rupees)
summary_fields.description: The amount the rider says was communicated at onboarding.

summary_fields.name: amount_matches
summary_fields.label: Deducted amount matches communicated amount
summary_fields.description: Is the amount actually deducted the same as the amount communicated?

summary_fields.name: deducted_amount
summary_fields.label: Amount actually deducted (rupees)
summary_fields.description: The amount the rider says was actually deducted from the payout.

summary_fields.name: payment_mode
summary_fields.label: Onboarding fee payment mode
summary_fields.description: Whether the rider paid the onboarding fee in one go or chose installments (only if mentioned).

summary_fields.name: upfront_amount_paid
summary_fields.label: Upfront amount paid (rupees)
summary_fields.description: Upfront amount the rider says they paid at onboarding (only if mentioned).

summary_fields.name: deduction_date_or_week
summary_fields.label: Deduction date / week
summary_fields.description: When the deduction appeared in the payout (only if mentioned or asked on a mismatch).

summary_fields.name: verification_status
summary_fields.label: Verification outcome
summary_fields.description: Outcome decided by the confirmed answers: consistent with onboarding information, a discrepancy between communicated and deducted amounts, or the amount was never communicated.

summary_fields.name: additional_concern
summary_fields.label: Additional concern about this deduction
summary_fields.description: Anything else the rider asked to be checked about this deduction, in their words.
